issues.description: Element: Bookstore initializer. Problem statement requires an initializer with signature `init(books: [Book])` (problem_statement.md lines 9-12). In the solution, Bookstore is implemented with `init()` (no parameters) whose body references an undefined local `books` variable (Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift in the solution, initializer at lines 14-16). Meanwhile the solution's Client constructs the bookstore using `Bookstore(books: books)` (Sources/BookstoreLib/Client.swift in the solution, line 57). This mismatch between the required constructor signature and the implemented one causes a compilation error and prevents students from using the intended API.
issues.suggestedFix: Implement the Bookstore initializer to match the problem statement and client usage. Replace the parameterless init with: `init(books: [Book]) { self.books = books }`. Ensure the parameter name and type exactly match `books: [Book]` so calls like `Bookstore(books: books)` compile and the stored property is correctly initialized.
